notes.title: Upgrades for Your Storage Chests!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/b112bccd6765bff4f02330a7ac90163812d42ea8.jpg[/img]


Are you running low on space? Worried you’ll have to start throwing away some of your prize possessions? Have no fear!

Between [b]midnight and 11:59 PM (CEST) on September 8, 2025[/b], you can pick up the Storage Chest Upgrade and get more space in your storage chests. Using it on a storage chest will upgrade it to the next level, giving you 10 more slots for your goodies.

The upgrade can be used on the following storage chests:
* Storage Chest (20 slots)
* Large Storage Chest (30 slots)
* Large Silver Storage Chest (40 slots)

If you use the upgrade on the Large Silver Storage Chest, you’ll get a Large Golden Storage Chest with a massive 50 available slots! That should give you plenty of space for all your most important treasures, so don’t let this great offer pass you by!

Happy upgrading,
The RoM Team

notes.title: [Coming Soon] NEW UPDATE: PASPER’S SHRINE (HARD)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/78f5f49c21341943f6f267fad19f69df7937fb98.jpg[/img]

There’s a new challenge waiting for the mightiest of Taborea’s adventurers! Dark forces around the [b]Pasper’s Shrine[/b] are up to no good and have created a distorted version of this ancient sanctum.

Are you ready for an adventure on which you will meet former allies and old friends? Then travel to Khant in the Sascilia Steppes. Bring a few capable friends, prepare well, and take on the corrupted enemies!

[img]https://secure-asset-delivery.gameforge.com/partnersite_live_product/0be9f40b-915b-45bb-a898-7bdc8f7158da/0f91a7e8-d8ff-4f58-90f8-bd25c585ebefpasper_entrance.jpg[/img]

Pasper’s Shrine (Hard) will be available to enter after the maintenance on [b]March 25[/b].

[h2]Pasper’s Shrine (Hard)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Requirements: both classes at level 100 + Peak Levels unlocked
[*]Entrance: Khant in the Sascilia Steppes
[*]Max. group size: 12 players
[/list]
[h3]Powerful Enemies[/h3]

The enemies should already be familiar to you from the first version of Pasper’s Shrine for level 45. But now they are much stronger and will surprise you with new attacks and tactics!
[list]
[*]Blackhorn Nisorn
[*]Blackhorn Dorglas
[*]Blackhorn Bareth
[*]Blackhorn Afalen
[*]Blackhorn Hafiz
[/list]
[img]https://secure-asset-delivery.gameforge.com/partnersite_live_product/0be9f40b-915b-45bb-a898-7bdc8f7158da/b38d48dd-92d3-4494-a2e8-d231318a448fpasper1.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Gear & Stats[/h3]

Those who dare to venture into the depths of the new shine will be richly rewarded! You’ll receive the rewards directly from the defeated bosses, as well as from various other sources which you can exchange with Adventurer Nathan:
[list]
[*]There are 5 new sets including head, chest, shoulder and foot armor with new stats and set bonuses!
[*]13 new weapons from the dungeon
[*]New shields, talismans and cloaks
[*]Many equipment updates can also be found with Proof of Myth Collectors, Phirius Armor Managers, Honor Clothing Merchants and Dreamland Pioneers
[/list]
[img]https://secure-asset-delivery.gameforge.com/partnersite_live_product/0be9f40b-915b-45bb-a898-7bdc8f7158da/cbdfce8c-2f0a-4e94-af5c-73702de1f4c1pasper2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Additional Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*]Daily quest: Head to the new NPC Adventurer Nathan at the instance entrance to receive [u]The Shadows of Corruption[/u] daily quest.
[*]10 new titles to unlock
[*]5 new cards to collect
[*]... and loads more!
[/list]

notes.title: Valentine's Day 2025
notes.content:
On Valentine's Day we want nothing better than to spoil our loved ones, smother them with kisses and bury them in presents. But that doesn't for one second mean we stop being stalwart adventurers of Taborea! We remain tireless in defending the innocents from the evils of the world.

[b][h2]Boost event[/h2][/b]
Help your fellow adventurers during these times of distraction and temptation! Get +300% EXP, TP and +200% Drop from 13.02.2025, 00:00 AM to 16.02.2025, 11:59 PM (Servertime)

[b][h2]Love is in the Timeless Instances[/h2][/b]
Love knows no bounds, not even in our timeless instances!
[list][*] From 27.01. to 02.02.2025, you will receive twice the amount of materials for upgrades from the final boss Dorlos in the Mystic Altar.
[*] From 03.02. to 09.02.2025, you will receive Lakishna's loot in the Mirror Chest in the Necropolis of Mirrors.[/list]
[b][h2]Letters from secret admirer[/h2][/b]
Between 10.02. and 14.02.2025 make sure you check your mailbox – who knows? Maybe you'll find something there from your secret admirer!

notes.title: [Coming Soon] NEW UPDATE: SHADOWS OVER THE ALTAR
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/f6802aac40602edc4cbde87244f18cce4c82c3ba.jpg[/img]

There’s a new challenge waiting for the mightiest of Taborea’s adventurers! Dark forces around the [b]Mystic Altar[/b] are up to no good and have created a distorted version of this ancient shrine.Only the bravest and most skillful heroes should rise to this challenge! Hence why a certain explorer who comes up short on both fronts is asking for your help: Loric has somewhat underestimated the dangers—and overestimated his abilities. Fortunately, there are sufficient treasures hidden in the depths of this parallel dimension to tempt a worthy champion...Are you ready for an adventure on which you will meet former allies and old friends? Are you prepared to have your skills stretched to their limit? Journey to the [b]Ystra Highlands near Snowhorn[/b] to reach the [b]Mystic Altar (Hard) on 25 April 2024[/b]. Bring a few capable friends on your journey, prepare well, and take on the seven bosses!

[previewyoutube=KQ-ibuCbTqg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The Mystic Altar (Hard)[/h3]
[list][*]Requirements: both classes at level 100 + Peak Levels unlocked and the Knowledge of the Ancestors quest from Shamar accepted[/*][*]Entrance: [b]Ystra Highlands[/b] near Snowhorn[/*][*]Max. group size: 12 players[/*][/list]
[h3]Powerful Enemies[/h3]
The enemies should already be familiar to you from the first version of the Mystic Altar for level 45. But now they are much stronger and will surprise you with new attacks and tactics!
[list][*]Flaming Nightmare[/*][*]Evil Ice Spirit[/*][*]Cursed Iron Golem[/*][*]Razeela[/*][*]Aukuda the Cursed[/*][*]Dorlos[/*][/list]
You’ll also have to go toe to toe against a new boss:
[list][*]Aukuda the Hero[/*][/list]

[h3]Outstanding Rewards[/h3]
Those who dare to venture into the new instance will be richly rewarded! You’ll receive the rewards directly from the defeated bosses, as well as from the various [b]Chests of the Mystic[/b], which you can exchange with Adventurer Loric.
[h3]Mystic’s Accessories[/h3]
Look out for earrings, rings and necklaces with powerful new stats and set bonuses!
[list][*]Accessories with Intelligence bonus: Astute Dark Mystic, Astute Sun Mystic and Astute Ancestral Mystic sets[/*][*]Accessories with Wisdom bonus: Enlightened Dark Mystic, Enlightened Sun Mystic and Enlightened Ancestral Mystic sets[/*][*]Accessories with Dexterity bonus: Quick Dark Mystic, Quick Sun Mystic and Quick Ancestral Mystic sets[/*][*]Accessories with Strength bonus: Wrathful Dark Mystic, Wrathful Sun Mystic and Wrathful Ancestral Mystic sets[/*][*]Accessories with Stamina bonus: Indomitable Dark Mystic, Indomitable Sun Mystic and Indomitable Ancestral Mystic sets[/*][/list][h3]Additional Rewards[/h3][list][*]Daily quest: Head to the new NPC Adventurer Loric at the instance entrance to receive the daily quest.[/*][*]New titles[/*][*]Peak Experience Points... and much more![/*][/list]

notes.title: Valentine's day 2024
notes.content:
On Valentine's Day we want nothing better than to spoil our loved ones, smother them with kisses and bury them in presents. But that doesn't for one second mean we stop being stalwart adventurers of Taborea! We remain tireless in defending the innocents from the evils of the world.

[h2]Boosts event[/h2]
Help your fellow adventurers during these times of distraction and temptation! Get +300% Exp ,TP and +200% Drop from 16.02.2024 00:00 AM to 18.02.2024 11:59 PM (Servertime)



[h2]Love is in the Mirrorworlds:[/h2]
Mirror, mirror on the wall, where's the most romantic loot of them all? Brace yourselves as love transcends dimensions in our Mirrorworlds! During this Valentine's Drop Event, hearts will rain down like confetti in these enchanted realms.



From 1st February to 15th February (maintenance to maintenance) the droprate of the specific Hearts in each mirroworld will be increased.



[h2]Letters from secret admirer[/h2]
Between 10.02. and 14.02.2024 make sure you check your mailbox – who knows? Maybe you'll find something there from your secret admirer!

notes.title: New Update: Reflection Of The Necropolis
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/9cefc643490b90b27e967b4411036d915b0f03e7.jpg[/img]

[b][u]
[/u][/b]

[b][u]Adventurers, brace yourself! Rumours of a new threat have been spreading in Taborea for some time. From the Dragonfang Ridge to the Redhill Mountains to the Syrbal Pass – everywhere there are whispers about a dark curse in the Necropolis of Mirrors. Even the eldest members of the Eye of Wisdom are concerned with the reports that have come to them...[/u][/b]

[b][u]
[/u][/b]

[b][u]A small group of adventurers went close to the Necropolis of Mirrors to collect rare magic crystals. But the crystals’ magic seems to have taken on abnormal proportions. Through a dimensional tear, they were pulled deep into the cave and encountered incredibly strong monsters. Not all of the adventurers made it out again...[/u][/b]

[h3]The Necropolis of Mirrors (Hard)[/h3]

Are you feeling curious and adventurous? Then go to Aslan South from [b]19th October 2023[/b] to get to the [b]Necropolis of Mirrors (Hard)[/b], where mighty enemies await you. So take some of your hero friends with you to face the five boss opponents.
[list][*]Requirements: both classes on level 100 + Peak Levels unlocked[/*][*]Entrance: Southern Aslan Valley[/*][*]Max. group size: 12 players[/*][/list]

[h3]Powerful Enemies[/h3]
The enemies in this instance should already be familiar to you from the first version of the Necropolis of Mirrors for levels 35-40. But now they are much stronger and surprise you with new attacks and tactics!
[list][*]Magister Gumas[/*][*]Androlier’s Shadow[/*][*]Androlier’s Strength[/*][*]Androlier’s Prisoner[/*][*]Krodamon & Krodamar[/*][/list]

[h3]Outstanding Rewards[/h3]
Those who dare to venture into the depths of this instance will be richly rewarded! You’ll receive the rewards directly from the defeated bosses, as well as from the precious [b]Chest of Mirrors[/b], which you can find deep within the instance.
[h3]Mirror Equipment[/h3]
Armor and weapon items with powerful [b]new stats and set bonuses[/b] await you!
[list][*]Cloth Armor for Mages: Mirror Mystery Set[/*][*]Cloth Armor for Healers: Luminous Mirror Set[/*][*]Leather Armor: Umbral Mirror Set[/*][*]Chain Armor: Mirror Strength Set[/*][*]Plate Armor: Mirror Bulwark Set[/*][*]Various weapons + Off-hand[/*][/list][h3]Additional Rewards[/h3][list][*]Daily quests: To receive the daily quest, go to the new NPC Adventurer Calym in  Howling Mountains (Logar) .[/*][*]New titles[/*][*]Peak Experience Points[/*][/list]
Have fun,The RoM Team

Ghosts and demons will be trying to use this witching season to escape from the realm of the dead. In their attempts to contact you on this side of the void, you’ll find some enticing items winging their way into your mailbox over the coming days. [b][u]Every day between 20th October and 26th October and on 31st, we’ll have a surprise in store for you![/u][/b]

notes.title: Patch 7.4.0.2989 - Pantheon Adjustments - Juice Festival - 14.09.2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/8c69a1c7ce8938ab4175f00682b0e2fd81a8e852.jpg[/img]

Next Thursday, 14.09.2023 we wish to release some important changes, and we wanted to share them with you as soon as possible.



Pantheon Adjustments

[list]
[*] Reduced monster levels in New Pantheon Normal Mode (z255) and Hard Mode (z254) to 105
[*] Changed required level in Peak Hunt quests to match the target boss level
[*] Granted additional experience when completing Peak Hunt quests if Peak Level is already unlocked
[*] 1.500.000 peak experience if boss is below level 25
[*] 2.500.000 peak experience if boss is below level 50 but above 25
[*] 4.000.000 peak experience if boss is below level 75 but above 50
[*] 6.000.000 peak experience if boss is below level 100 but above 75
[/list]


Note:

as mentioned 14.09 is a desired date, might always differ for technical reasons.

Tomorrow, it’s time again for our popular Flash Auction! Come and get your hands on powerful items at amazingly low prices: on Sundat, 20th August at 6 PM, top offers are waiting for you again!

[b]How?[/b]
Simply check out the [b]Flash Auction[/b] in the item shop and bid for your favourite item when the price is lowest. 

[b]What’re Flash Auctions?[/b]
Flash Auctions aren’t any ordinary auctions, as the [b]item prices constantly drop[/b]. 
The longer you wait to place a bid, the cheaper you can pick up the items. But these are only available in the shop for 15 minutes and in limited quantity. You’ll have to be quick on the trigger to pick up the best deals!

[b]When?[/b]
The Flash Auction will start at [b]6 PM (CEST) on 20th August[/b].

notes.title: Patch 7.4.0.2977 - Pumpkin Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/f5b26fa056c22a151f5653943a95499b263420bf.png[/img]

[h2]Pumpkin Festival[/h2]

[i]When the Eye of Wisdom first came to Candara, the land was very underdeveloped. There was a great shortage of lumber, a farmer used a pumpkin to carve a mask like these and then when he put a candle inside, it seemed to come to life.

When the leaders at the Eye of Wisdom heard of this, they marked this day as a day of celebration so that the people could take a rest before the hard winter. Everyone put on these pumpkin masks and gathered to enjoy a friendly chat and some delicious pumpkin dishes. Later, children would put on these masks and dress up as monsters then visit their neighbor's houses to ask for candy.

First it was only the game of a few children, but over time a custom developed and now the day is set in the calendar as Pumpkin Festival. Children still dress as monsters and ask everyone for candy or try to scare them. And they shout: 'Trick or Treat!'[/i]

notes.title: Winter Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/0c2e4130f5d941b31e8abc1dbe1c77f0bed7cb2c.jpg[/img]


The Advent season is upon us and the first snow is falling over Taborea. People across the land are preparing and getting into the festive spirit…


But new adventures lurk around every corner in this land of magic. This year is no different, as wild monsters walk abroad once more, and we plan a host of exciting events.


So get your weapons polished up ready and come by regularly to find full details on all our winter events.
[h2]	[url=https://forum.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/forum/thread/8905-christmas-event-2021-ideas/?postID=75393][/url][b]Fun in the Snow[/b][/h2]
The snow has fallen through the night, covering Taborea in a soft blanket that sparkles in the rays of the rising sun. Children waking to this piping cold rush out into the deep, cold fleece with peals of laughter to join the great snowball fight. But their good-natured missiles occasionally go astray, hitting monsters who lash out furiously and prime themselves to attack.



Can you protect the children? Earn yourself a boost event in reward!
[list]	[*][b]Between December 10th (12:00 AM) time and December 12th (11:59 PM server local time) [/b]you will gain +100% boost in drop rates.[b][/b][/*]	[*][b]Between December 17th (12:00 AM) time and December 19th (11:59 PM server local time)[/b]  you will gain +150% Experience from quests and mobs and +150% talent points from mobs.[/*]	[*][b]Between December 24th (12:00 AM) and January 2nd, 2021 (11:59 PM server local time)[/b] you will gain + 300% Experience from quests and mobs, +300% talent points from mobs, and a +200% boost in drop rates.[/*]	[*][b]Between January 6th (12:00 AM) and January 9th, 2021 (11:59 PM server local time)[/b] you will gain + 150% Experience from quests and mobs, +150% talent points from mobs, and a +100% boost in drop rates.[/*][/list]
Please note, that drop boost is applied, when players are in the party.
[h2]	[url=https://forum.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/forum/thread/8905-christmas-event-2021-ideas/?postID=75393][/url][b]Presents from Santa Claus[/b][/h2]
Do you still remember the days when you wrote letters to Santa? In Taborea, it’s the other way around – over the Christmas season, Santa and his helpers will send you letters containing little gifts!


Don’t miss out on any of these cool deliveries. There’s a surprise in store for you every day [b]between December 20th and January 1st, 2022[/b], and you can look forward to various useful items to help you on your adventures. If you have multiple characters on your account, the presents will land in the mailbox of the first character you log in with. Even if you miss a day during this period, it won’t have any effect on the remaining presents.
[h2]	[url=https://forum.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/forum/thread/8905-christmas-event-2021-ideas/?postID=75393][/url][b]XMas Trader:[/b][/h2]
[b]During the event from December 23rd (12:00 PM) until January First maintenance, Owenstein and his friends will exchange Moas Cores for different rewards.[/b]

[b]Don't forget to visit them![/b]





Have fun with the events!

The RoM Team.

[h2]Pumpkin Festival[/h2]

[i]When the Eye of Wisdom first came to Candara, the land was very underdeveloped. There was a great shortage of lumber, a farmer used a pumpkin to carve a mask like these and then when he put a candle inside, it seemed to come to life.

When the leaders at the Eye of Wisdom heard of this, they marked this day as a day of celebration so that the people could take a rest before the hard winter. Everyone put on these pumpkin masks and gathered to enjoy a friendly chat and some delicious pumpkin dishes. Later, children would put on these masks and dress up as monsters then visit their neighbor's houses to ask for candy.

First it was only the game of a few children, but over time a custom developed and now the day is set in the calendar as Pumpkin Festival. Children still dress as monsters and ask everyone for candy or try to scare them. And they shout: 'Trick or Treat!'[/i]

notes.title: We're combining Servers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/9f871111eedd775881275afb0b0f430690307463.jpg[/img]


As announced, we’re merging some of the European and two US servers next week to give you a more exciting and varied gaming experience in Runes of Magic.
[h3]The server merge[/h3]
These are the new names of the merge servers:
[list]    [*]INT1: Gaia[/*]    [*]EU4: Aynara[/*]    [*]EU5: Kadmos[/*]    [*]US1: Ayvenas[/*][/list]
The servers were merged as follows:
[list]    [*]EU1 (EN) Vidar + EU11 (FR) Nuada + EU12 (ES) Ibergard + EU17 (PL) Nawia + EU23 (EN) Idun → [b]INT1 (EN) Gaia[/b][/*]    [*]EU10 (DE) Rath + EU4 (DE) Asteria → [b]EU4 (DE) Aynara[/b][/*]    [*]EU24 (DE) Zikiel + EU5 (DE) Garda + EU6 (DE) Baldr → [b]EU5 (DE) Kadmos[/b][/*]    [*]US1 Aeterna + US8 Phoenix → [b]US1 (EN) Ayvenas[/b][/*][/list] [h3]What’s new:[/h3]
Shop offers which are currently only available on the new servers will also be made available on the new servers!

We have also changed the Ruby system: you can continue spending rubies on the same items as you have before. However, there will be no more payback for purchases.

We will add the Training Range event on all servers.
[h3]Any more questions?[/h3]
If you’d like to learn more about the server merge, you can read our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/808290/view/2996568545566360934]FAQ[/url].

We wish you all full servers, tons of fun and loads of action with plenty of new RoM friends!The RoM Team

notes.title: Server Merge FAQ
notes.content:
[h2]The most important info about the merge[/h2]
[b]Will a merge of the servers affect the release of new content and new bugfixes?[/b]No. The merge is a completely independent Gameforge project. In the meantime, Runewaker will continue working on the game and corresponding updates as usual.

[b]Which servers are planned to be merged and when will it take place?[/b]As already announced, we’ll be merging some European servers and two US servers.

These are the new names of the merge servers:
[list][*]INT1: [b]Gaia[/b][/*][*]EU4: [b]Aynara[/b][/*][*]EU5: [b]Kadmos[/b][/*][*]US1: [b]Ayvenas[/b][/*][/list]
The servers will be merged as follows:
[list][*]EU1 (EN) Vidar + EU11 (FR) Nuada + EU12 (ES) Ibergard + EU17 (PL) Nawia + EU23 (EN) Idun → [b]INT1 (EN) Gaia[/b][/*][*]EU10 (DE) Rath + EU4 (DE) Asteria → [b]EU4 (DE) Aynara[/b][/*][*]EU24 (DE) Zikiel + EU5 (DE) Garda + EU6 (DE) Baldr → [b]EU5 (DE) Kadmos[/b][/*][*]US1 Aeterna + US8 Phoenix → [b]US1 (EN) Ayvenas[/b][/*][/list]
The exact times of the server mergers will be announced separately on our homepage, social media and the official forums.

[b]Notes about the shop:[/b]Shop offers which are currently only available on Kerub and Svidur will also be made available on the new servers! 

We have also changed the Ruby system: you can continue spending rubies on the same items as you have before. However, there will be no more refunds for purchases.
[h2]General Merge Information[/h2]
[b]Which criteria will be used when considering accounts for the server merge?[/b]There are no restrictions with regard to the accounts. We will merge all accounts.

[b]What will happen to inactive accounts and players who return after years of inactivity?[/b]They will be able to log in and play on the newly merged servers.

[b]Do players have to transfer their accounts or will this happen automatically?[/b]We will handle the merging of the servers. That means it will happen automatically. Almost like magic.

[b]Will the game be shut down separately or will this be taken care of during the regular maintenance?[/b]The server merge will not take place during a regular maintenance, and the respective servers will be shut down.We will start with smaller servers and soon thereafter continue with the remaining planned server mergers.

[b]How long will the servers be offline during the server merges?[/b]It will certainly take longer than a regular server maintenance, but we cannot give an exact time.

[b]Can players decide, themselves, which server they want to be transferred to?[/b]No, the accounts will be merged according to the combinations listed.

[b]Will servers be merged across countries?[/b]Yes, the international server is the result of merging EN+ FR + PL + EU.

[b]How many servers will be permanently merged together as one, and what are the criteria for this?[/b]The number of servers to be merged can vary from group to group since we have chosen the size of the server population as the deciding criterion.

[b]Have you considered the economics of the individual servers?[/b]The most important criterion is the server population. We have weighed the pros and cons and came to the conclusion that a perfect economy means nothing if there are too few players. Therefore, we have decided that population plays a bigger role than the other aspects.

[b]Will there be multiple channels on the merged servers?[/b]Not at the beginning. But if more channels are needed after the merge, we will consider it.
[h2]Specific server merge information[/h2]
[b]What will happen to characters with the same name?[/b]If two characters with the same name end up on the same server, the character with the highest level (regardless of class or class level) will retain their name.If both characters are of the same level, the deciding factor will be made based on pure playtime, i.e. the character which has been played the longest.

[b]What happens with guilds which have the same name?[/b]The guild with the highest level will keep their name. If their levels are the same, the guild on the target server will retain their name.

[b]How will conflicting housing numbers be handled?[/b]The houses that are moved will receive a new number and will be assigned to their respective character. This way no one will end up in another player’s house.

[b]What happens if I have more than 8 characters on my account after the merger?[/b]In this case, you will still be able to play all your characters as normal. But you will not be able to create new characters until you have fewer than 8 characters.

[b]Will the merge affect my characters in any? (Items, gold, XP/TP, jobs, pets etc.)[/b]No, everything connected with your character will be transferred.

[b]Will the merger affect my house or my house servants?[/b]No, the house itself and everything belonging to it is connected to the character and will therefore be transferred over.

[b]What will happen to my Friend List, Blacklist and relationships?[/b]Everything should stay the way it is now, but some characters may have new names.

[b]What will happen to inactive guilds? Will they also be transferred over?[/b]Since we are merging all accounts including inactive ones, inactive guilds will also be carried over.

[b]What effects will the merge have on the Auction House? Will it be closed and cleared before the merge?[/b]The auctions will not be transferred. But before the merge takes places, all auctions will be cancelled, and the items will be returned to their seller. After the merge, you will have to put these items back up for auction if you want to sell them.

[b]What will happen to the furniture in my house and the guild castle?[/b]Everything connected to your character will be merged.

[b]What will happen to the letters I have in the Mailbox during the merge?[/b]After the merge is complete, everything will be there.

[b]Will the server merge result in changes to Siege War?[/b]No, there will be no changes to Siege War due to the server merge. The system works independent of the number of servers and will thus not require any adjustments.

[b]What will happen to the Magic Wardrobe?[/b]You don’t have to worry about your Magic Wardrobe. Players on some servers will have to log in to Account Management on our homepage. There, these players can then transfer their costumes to the new server. If there are still costumes from an earlier server merger stored there, these can also be transferred.

notes.title: Patch 7.4.0.2940 - Colorweave Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/555124bd51da145765824f5ae236a899ca0c4367.jpg[/img] [h2][b]Colorweave Festival[/b][/h2] [u]Legend has it that the earliest people didn't wear clothes. When bad weather came, they couldn't do anything but huddle together for warmth and wait for it to pass. The weak and feeble gritted their teeth and endured the cold without help from anyone. People would die from exposure if there was a cold snap. They were slaves to the weather. [/u] [u] [/u] [u]Then one night, the gods dispatched an envoy wearing clothes that were seemingly weaved from a rainbow. Just to look upon their brilliance was to be bathed in soft, soothing moonlight. Her name was Lunella, and she came to teach people how to weave clothes and survive winter's cruelty. This event marked the very beginning of our concept of beauty. Afterwards, a few pioneers popped up and started experimenting with dressing up. They designed new styles that focused not just on warmth, but on the beautiful and vibrant too. [/u] [u] [/u] [u]After the people had mastered weaving, Lunella quietly made her exit. She has not been seen since. In order to honor the memory of Lunella's graciousness, people prepare their most beautiful clothes and come together every year at this time. The festival is meant to symbolize the permanence of Lunella's teachings. They will continue to be handed down and live forever in the minds of generations to come.[/u]

Have fun in our summer events! 
The RoM Team

notes.title: Server Transfer Made Simple
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/4c8316a9906837d5c5c1e36971cb17130c910abe.png[/img]

Your hero has experienced thrilling adventure, overcome perilous ordeals and fought in epic battles. Is it now time to move on to new climes? It couldn’t be any easier!

Then this is your chance – transfer your character to the server of your choice now. All you’ll need is the [b]Server Transfer Stone[/b].

You can get the Server Transfer Stone in the shop. Plus, you also have a small chance of winning it as a reward in the Training Range event on the new servers.

[b]Notes[/b]

Please note the following before transferring servers:

[list]    [*]YYou can only transfer your character from Kerub/Svidur to one of the old servers in the same region with the Server Transfer Stone.[/*]    [*]The minimum level for transferring a character is level 85. Only once you’ve reached this level can your character be transferred to another server.[/*]    [*]A server transfer is possible only after receiving the Server Transfer Stone and exiting the game and logging back in.[/*]    [*]You must have a Server Transfer Stone in your inventory.[/*]    [*]With the stone in your inventory, you can register the transfer in the game account settings in the Gameforge Client or via the RoM website.[/*]    [*]The transfer will not be performed immediately, but will occur during the next server maintenance. Until then you can continue playing as usual, but be sure not to remove the transfer stone from your inventory![/*]    [*]You can also cancel the transfer before the next server maintenance if you change your mind.[/*]    [*]Transferring a character includes their progress and inventory. Guilds, friends lists, messages, houses, Magic Wardrobes, Rubies, items not retrieved from the mailbox or the Auction House and active auctions are not transferred.[/*]    [*]If the character name already exists on the target server, the character must be renamed after logging in on the new server.[/*]    [*]The item cannot be traded and thus needs to be purchased via the character that should be transferred.[/*]    [*]To purchase it in the shop, you will need to have spent a certain amount of premium currency on the new servers.[/*]    [*]if you play on Steam please follow this link:    [list]        [*][url=https://en.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin]https://en.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin[/url][/*]        [*][url=https://us.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin]https://us.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin[/url][/*]        [*][url=https://de.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin]https://de.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin[/url][/*]        [*][url=https://pl.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin]https://pl.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin[/url][/*]        [*][url=https://fr.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin]https://fr.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin[/url][/*]        [*][url=https://es.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin]https://es.runesofmagic.gameforge.com/user/steamlogin[/url][/*]    [/list]    [/*][/list]

In the server selection overview the character numbers might be not updated even if the transfer was successfully

Have fun on the server of your choice!

The RoM Team

[b]Crafting Festival

[/b]

[u]A long time ago, the world was very chaotic. Nations were engaged in an endless war, and the people didn't dare imagine what tomorrow would bring. Many families were impoverished and displaced.[/u]

[u]After a long time the war finally came to an end, and the craftsmen who had been forced to produce weapons used their skills to help the people. All of the craftsmen were happy to be able to stop making weapons and contribute something to the people. They worked hard to make people happy.[/u]

[u]By working from before dawn until late into the night, the tireless efforts of these craftsmen improved the lives of the people in a short six months. notes.title: Spring in the Taborean Air
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/6da205d9ecbb70a68fc1c70f247936c01df42986.jpg[/img]

Winter is slowing losing its icy grip on the lands. All across Taborea, Wabbits are emerging from bushes and burrows to enjoy the gentle sunshine. Wabbits and clement weather – what else do you need to celebrate spring in Taborea? Ah, of course! Events! If you prefer to celebrate the holidays with exhilarating action rather than relaxation, we’ve got just the thing.

[h2]    [b]Boosts event[/b][/h2]

[b]Between 02.04. 00:00 AM and 05.04.2021 11:59 PM (local server time respectively)[/b] you can look forward to more experience and talent points, plus higher drop rates:

[b]On the old servers:[/b]
[list]    [*]EXP +200% (from quests and mobs)[/*]    [*]TP Boost +200% (from mobs)[/*]    [*]Loot chance +200%[/*][/list]
[b]On the new servers:[/b]
[list]    [*]EXP +350% (from quests and mobs)[/*]    [*]TP +350% (from mobs)[/*]    [*]Loot chance +275%[/*][/list]
Please note that the drop boost will only be active while you are in a group.

[h2]    [b]Easter Gift[/b][/h2]

There’s a surprise in store for you every day [b]between 02.04. and 05.04.2021[/b], and you can look forward to various useful items to help you on your adventures. If you have multiple characters on your account, the presents will land in the mailbox of the first character you log in with. Even if you miss a day during this period, it won’t have any effect on the remaining presents.

Have fun!
The RoM Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/ed65203989fb01f5ba925f9cd2ed9b699583ace9.jpg[/img]

You can feel the jubilant excitement in the air in Taborea as Runes of Magic celebrates its 12-year anniversary! Together we have enjoyed 12 magical years full of adventure performing heroic deeds. We want to thank you for your loyalty on the journey we’ve shared! So we’ve prepared some big anniversary events for you.

Celebrate with us from 18th March (after the server maintenance) until 25th March (start of the server maintenance) and enjoy the many benefits:
[h3][b]Boost Event[/b][/h3]
Play, have fun, and scoop up the loot! During the event there’s more experience and talent points to be earned, plus higher drop rates:

Please note that the drop boost will only be active while you are in a group. 
[h3][b]Login Event[/b][/h3]
Log in each day and collect gifts for RoM’s birthday! Each day we’ll be sending you a different present per in-game parcel. If you have multiple characters on your account, the presents will land in the mailbox of the first character you log in with. Even if you miss a day during this period, it won’t have any effect on the remaining presents.
[h3][b]Anniversary Raffle[/b][/h3]
Take part in our [url=https://gf.link/RoM12thAnniversaryRaffle]Big Anniversary Raffle[/url]. We have 12 coupons to give-out. Maybe you’ll be among the lucky winners? Simply click on the link and follow the instructions to participate.

Have fun at the party!
The RoM Team

notes.title: The New Servers Are Coming on 26.02!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/330fea2ff943df94779c6b6a88742efaf51b211f.jpg[/img]

As previously announced, on Friday February 26th (12:00 CET) we will proudly present to you [b]two brand-new servers[/b]: one German and one international. Best of all: we’re giving you some awesome bonuses and fast leveling so you can really hit the ground running!

[h2]    [b]Be the First![/b][/h2]

The new servers come with special rewards each time a challenge is completed for the first time.

There are also titles for unlocking achievements for the first time in your class or race, or in a party or dungeon. And you can also celebrate combo achievements, of course. But most important are the powerful buffs you’ll get along the way:

[h2]    [b]Powerful Buffs for Winners[/b][/h2]

There’s a total of 93 different titles for you to unlock, each of which comes with a powerful buff. These buffs are much more potent than the ones you are used to from the old servers—so title hunting really pays off!

What do you have to do? Achieve one or more of these [b]objectives[/b]:
[list]    [*]Be the first player on your server to reach level 55, 85, or 100.[/*]    [*]Be the first player on your server and in your class to reach level 55, 85, or 100.[/*]    [*]Be the first player on your server in your class and race to reach level 100.[/*]    [*]Be the first player on your server to reach the highest qualification level of a crafting skill.[/*]    [*]Be a member of the party that clears one of the following dungeons first:    [list]        [*]Grotto of Horror[/*]        [*]Tomb of Souls[/*]        [*]Sun Temple of Eternal Sleep[/*]        [*]Vale of Rites[/*]        [*]Ice Blade Plateau[/*]        [*]Pantheon[/*]    [/list]    [/*][/list]
There are three different rewards for achievements in dungeons, depending on the selected difficulty level.

[h2]    [b]Special Event[/b][/h2]

From the very start there will be some awesome events on the new servers to make leveling up easier. Not only will be benefit from increased XP but also from many bonuses that you’ll be able to use to develop your skills faster than before!

In our Training Range special event, you’ll face off against multiple waves of nasty monsters. For each wave you beat, you’ll receive experience points and you’ll be able to choose one of several reward chests. The first entry each day is free—and you’ll be able to buy additional entries, of course.

[h2]    [b]Reward Chests[/b][/h2]

You can choose one of five chests: each chest contains a random item from these categories:
[list]    [*]Pets[/*]    [*]Zodiac Pets and Draco Pets[/*]    [*]Cenedrils[/*]    [*]Titles[/*]    [*]Badges of the Trial[/*][/list]
[h2]    [b]Powerful Boosts[/b][/h2]

Start you hero’s journey on one of the two new servers and level up fast! Be there from the beginning as the servers are launching with a 200% bonus on XP and TP, and a 100% bonus on item drops. Even when these bonuses are scaled back at a later date, you’ll still be able to count on bonuses on these servers, all of which exceed the perks of the old servers!

This is our boost roadmap on the new servers for the coming weeks:
[olist]    [*]Flower Festival: +200% XP and TP, and +100% loot[/*]    [*]Anniversary Festival: +150% XP and TP, and +75% loot[/*]    [*]Spring Rain Festival: +100% XP and TP, and +50% loot[/*]    [*]Music Festival: +50% XP and TP, and +25% loot[/*][/olist]
[h2]    [b]Possibility to Switch[/b][/h2]

notes.title: A word from Product Manager: new servers and the future
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/3da2465c0fb3a2a5a6f5c8cd33c0025698208ab9.jpg[/img]

Hello dear Community,

As you are all already aware, we will be opening two new servers soon, and this has raised some questions concerning the fate of the current servers and what will happen with them.

Do not be worried, we are not going to abandon the current servers and our long-term users just to concentrate on the new servers, we do have some plans, and I will be explaining some of them here.

[h2][b]Server Merge[/b][/h2]

We will merge the older servers, but this is a project that takes a lot of time and should be planned in the correct way. That is why we went with a counter-intuitive way of opening the new servers before merging the old ones. Since we are all aware that the current state of the game tends to block with a higher number of active players that are online at any given moment, we must calculate how to merge the servers to get an optimal situation. If we merge the servers in a way that ends up with a sub-par number of online players at any given moment, we have failed to address the problem of the low population on the servers. If on the other hand, we merge so that the numbers are too high, it might look nice from that point of view, but would most likely lead to an unstable server environment and crashes and offline times that could have been prevented with better planning. In the past, we noticed that new server opening led to a rise in the number of players, some from the influx of new users, and some from reactivation of old ones. Even though it might look that those numbers should not impact the situation on the old servers, considering the fact that we would merge, it might lead to the too-high numbers and unhappiness from you due to not being able to play the game for some time after the unplanned interruption of services. Once the numbers are stabilized, we will merge the current servers in an optimal way.

[h2][b]Durability of new servers[/b][/h2]

Unlike the last time when we opened temporary “catch up” servers, these ones are here to stay. We will not be closing them, but we have learned some things from the catch-up servers that we intend to implement in the very near future. What it is will be revealed in a few days by our Community Management, and I personally think it is something that will show you that we are still working on the game alongside with Runewaker.

[h2][b]New servers – New settings[/b][/h2]

At the start, new servers will have an increased XP, TP and Drop chance. Over time, those values will drop down, and at some point, will most probably become the same as the current live servers, but that is something that we will keep an eye on. It is possible that we will keep a higher setting on these servers, but not something that we are ready to decide on in advance. These special bonuses will only apply to the new servers, but whenever the usual rotation of bonuses hits the current servers, the new servers will get a bonus to their bonus as well.

[h2][b]New Titles and rewards[/b][/h2]

We have created new titles for the fastest players, which will give out some very nice bonuses to people who get them. In order to be the first, you will have to apply yourself and hurry up. The full list of new titles will be given out later by Community Management.

[h2][b]New Servers and Merge[/b][/h2]

These new servers might end up being merged in the future, but not in the next merge. They are new, different in some ways, and do not fall into consideration for the merge list yet.

[h2][b]New content[/b][/h2]

At the moment, we are in discussion about the possibility of new content and are hoping to give out more new content very soon. There are more things planned to come out, mainly fixes for major issues already in the game, and some new things concerning the end game content. More information will come when we have things set up and confirmed from both sides.

[h2][b]Level Cap[/b][/h2]

New servers will have the same Level Cap as the current live servers.

I hope this answers the most important questions that you might have concerning this topic and confirms to you that we are going to continue improving the game in the future.

Product Manager and RoM Team.

notes.title: Event: Dasein’s Labyrinth
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32991126/eb74b1f31991c9fa3628fa1165e4a8874bdbdbc1.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Heroes of Taborea! 

We’re opening the gates to a brand-new event zone! [b]Between January 26th and February 4th, 2021[/b], all players [b]from level 75[/b] can take on the challenges of Dasein’s Labyrinth!

[h1][b]Who and How?[/b][/h1]

The portal can be found near the bridge in Varanas. The entry fee can be paid in gold or items, but note that each time you enter on the same day, the fee will increase. The price is reset again every night around 2 AM.

After paying, you’ll be transported to the starting area where you can choose either to take on the labyrinth or enter the boss zone.

[h1][b]The Labyrinth[/b][/h1]

Inside the labyrinth, you have 3 minutes in which to find as many treasure chests as you can. The chests come in two different ‘flavors’: purple chests contain more valuable items than the red chests, but the former can only be opened using keys you find in the red chests. You’ll also come across traps which either slow you down or speed you up. 

[h1][b]Dasein Boss Battle[/b][/h1]

You’ll need every ounce of your strength and cunning against Dasein. Only a fool would dare face her alone – you wouldn’t stand a chance! 

Have fun with the event!

[h2]	[b]Fire Festival[/b][/h2]

[i]In the past, when the frost and snow fell and the moon disappeared from the sky, the Frostmoon Demon Beast Thysdyr would awaken from his sleep and cause destruction everywhere. At the time, the people had no way to stop him, so they could only flee. They would wait for Thysdyr to leave, then return to rebuild their homes. The villagers lived through this nightmare year after year, until one year at this time, a strangely-dressed traveller came to visit even though he knew the terrible beast would attack.

That night, as Thysdyr's angry roar drew nearer and nearer, the traveller sat in the empty city, quietly waiting...

The next day, the villagers returned to find their village untouched. Surprised, they asked the traveller what had happened. It turns out that Thysdyr was afraid of rune-catalyzed flame. This exciting news spread quickly to all the nearby villages. After that, every time the Frostmoon Beast awoke, he could only continue to hide in the darkness.

Many years have passed, and Thysdyr hasn't been seen for a long time. But every year when the snowy season arrives, people build a giant pyre and dance around it, throwing in rune catalysts. They celebrate day and night and call the celebration the Festival of Fire.[/i]

notes.title: Winter Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/0c2e4130f5d941b31e8abc1dbe1c77f0bed7cb2c.jpg[/img]

The Advent season is upon us and the first snow is falling over Taborea. People across the land are preparing and getting into the festive spirit…

But new adventures lurk around every corner in this land of magic. This year is no different, as wild monsters walk abroad once more, and we plan a host of exciting events.

So get your weapons polished up ready and come by regularly to find full details on all our winter events.

[h2][b]Fun in the Snow[/b][/h2]

The snow has fallen through the night, covering Taborea in a soft blanket that sparkles in the rays of the rising sun. Children waking to this piping cold rush out into the deep, cold fleece with peals of laughter to join the great snowball fight. But their good-natured missiles occasionally go astray, hitting monsters who lash out furiously and prime themselves to attack.

Can you protect the children? Earn yourself a boost event in reward!
[list]    [*][b]Between December 11th (12:00 AM) time and December 13th (11:59 PM server local time)[/b] you will gain +150% Experience from quests and mobs and +150% talent points from mobs.[/*]
    [*][b]Between December 18th (12:00 AM) time and December 20th (11:59 PM server local time)[/b] you will gain +100% boost in drop rates.[/*]
    [*][b]Between December 25th (12:00 AM) and January 3rd, 2021 (11:59 PM server local time)[/b] you will gain + 300% Experience from quests and mobs, +300% talent points from mobs, and a +200% boost in drop rates.[/*][/list]
Please note, that drop boost is applied, when players are in the party.

[h2]    [b]Daily Presents from Santa Claus[/b][/h2]

Do you still remember the days when you wrote letters to Santa? In Taborea, it’s the other way around – over the Christmas season, Santa and his helpers will send you letters containing little gifts!

Don’t miss out on any of these cool deliveries. There’s a surprise in store for you every day [b]between December 14th and January 1st, 2021[/b], and you can look forward to various useful items to help you on your adventures. If you have multiple characters on your account, the presents will land in the mailbox of the first character you log in with. Even if you miss a day during this period, it won’t have any effect on the remaining presents.

[h2]    [b]Festive Action Feeling[/b][/h2]

While Taborea glitters under the cold mantle of winter, the people are busy preparing delicious feasts and sharpening their weapons. Meanwhile, what with the Snowflake Festival and New Year’s celebrations, even the most ferocious monsters are getting into the festive spirit. In fact, they’re carrying presents with them that any valiant adventurer can “liberate”… assuming they have the guts to take them by force. If you’re not afraid of diving into the thick of battle, don’t let this opportunity slip away.

[b]During the event from December 15th (12:00 PM) to January 3rd, 2021 (11:59 PM server local time)[/b], rally your friends and guild mates together and defeat the monsters all over Taborea and get awesome prizes:
[list]    [*]In Pantheon (easy mode) all bosses will drop Coin of Wind (1 Day). Just remember that each boss only carries a certain number of items, irrespective of how many fighters defeat them.[/*]
    [*]In Sardo Castle (normal mode) Hidden Box and in Aeternal Circle (normal mode) Force Golem Sentry  will hide Proofs of Myth.[/*]

notes.title: Patch 7.4.0.2923 - Snowflake Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/e7b0824c224b7d5adab62c9ceba084db370f569c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Snowflake Festival[/h2]

[i]Zachariel was a Great Mage of the Eye of Wisdom from the time 400 years ago when the Eye of Wisdom was still residing on the Kolydian continent. He was well known because of his benevolent deeds. In the midst of a harsh winter he would provide the needy with supplies.

Once the people of the Eye of Wisdom had come to Candara, they decided to keep this habit in order to foster a peaceful relationship with the local people. When the season of heavy snow had come they would, just as Zachariel had done, wear a red robe and provide the local people with supplies. This gesture helped many endure the long winters and also built trust between the people and the Eye of Wisdom. Soon we were doing this every winter and it became a custom and was named the Snowflake Festival.

After the Phirius Workshops had been set up, they meant to take advantage of this custom and decided to make some modifications to the red robe and thereafter let their people wear these robes while delivering presents to little children. Their actions won many praises from the people and also allowed them to make more money.

The Phirius Workshops taking a fancy to this custom would make the Snowflake Festival an even bigger event in the years to come. Each year more and more people took part in these activities creating this wonderful and exciting atmosphere that we can experience during the winter season nowadays.[/i]

notes.title: Halloween Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/a097e0818de1f036b06c80ef747e4a15ed491768.jpg[/img]

Are you strong and fearless? Then we have spooktacular events for you! Look forward to daily gifts, huge boosts, offers in the shop and, of course, the Haunted House event!

[h2]    [b]Message from the Beyond[/b][/h2]

Ghosts and demons will be trying to use this witching season to escape from the realm of the dead. In their attempts to contact you on this side of the void, you’ll find some enticing items winging their way into your mailbox over the coming days.

Every day between 27th October and 5th November we’ll have a surprise in store for you! If you have multiple characters on your account, the presents will land in the mailbox of the first character you log in with. Even if you miss a day during this period, it won’t have any effect on the remaining presents.

[h2]    [b]Tricks for Treats[/b][/h2]

Trick OR treat? We offer both!
Play tricks on the wild pumpkins, monsters and demons from 30th October (midnight) to 1st November (11:59 PM server time) and look forward to the sweet treats:
[list]    [*]300% additional XP[/*]    [*]300% more talent points[/*]    [*]200% drop boost if you play in a group[/*][/list]
[h2]    [b]Halloween in the Shop[/b][/h2]

To go with our spooky events, we’ve got a number of offers for you in the shop: get Transformation Potions, pets, event items, mounts, including the Dagger Skeleton mount or costumes like the Frighty Bear Costume!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/206f34c7451cb02b90e1bf3d63d1009e653f2a3b.jpg[/img]

[h2]    [b]The Haunted House[/b][/h2]

Do you dare enter the haunted house? The show how fearless you are [b]until 5th November[/b] and snatch exciting prizes!

Solve puzzles, enter the haunted house, kill the boss, and scoop some awesome rewards! Here’s how it works: the Team Manager NPC at the entrance to Varanas will grant you access to the event zone, and you’ll be able to participate from level 75!

[h3][b]Garden and Haunted House[/b][/h3]

In the first part, the garden, you’ll have to find the mechanisms that’ll open the doors to the mansion. But don’t let yourself get caught by the ghosts while you’re doing so! 
The second part takes place inside the mansion: there’s an epic boss battle against an evil ghost and unique rewards waiting for you.

[h3][b]4 Game Modes[/b][/h3]

The different modes are Solo, Easy (2 players), Normal (2-4 players:), and Hard (3-6 players).
Solo mode only takes place in the first part, the garden.

[h3]    [b]Entry Cost[/b][/h3]

You can obtain entry to Solo and Easy modes from the Team Manager NPC for gold.
For Normal mode you need the Mysterious Golden Key item, which are dropped in each mode with a certain probability, or you can purchase them in the shop.
Hard mode can only be accessed with the Mysterious Transport Medium item, which you can purchase in the shop.

[h3]    [b]Potential Prizes[/b][/h3]

The rewards for your heroic deeds are awfully awesome: get the Pumpkin Carriage mount, the Shady O’Ghoul pet, and various brand-new transformation potions – there’s everything from zombies and krakens to banshees and dragons!

Happing haunting!
The RoM Team

notes.title: A Golden Autumn Full of Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/951475f861b0fbb8c877161fe113f8faa2eeed30.jpg[/img]

Autumn is coming, but we’d rather have sun and pleasantly warm weather than rain and storms, of course. So get prepared for the Golden Autumn event!

[h3]How It Works:[/h3]

A fun time packed full of thrilling tasks and valuable benefits awaits you! Each week in Taborea you’ll enjoy a different, exciting event. This includes boost events and an event where you can get your hands on the prized Proofs of Myth and Peak Experience Orb as well as some useful consumables and food.

[h2]Event 1: As Much as You Can Carry[/h2]

[b]Duration: 12th October (midnight) to 18th October (11:59 PM local time of the server)[/b]

Grab more loot: receive a drop rate increased by 200% during the event – this is your chance to get shiny, new armor for your adventure!

Please note that “Drop Boost” will be used if you play in a group.

[h2]Event 2: Provisions for Colder Months[/h2]

[b]Duration: 12th October (12 PM) to 20th October (until the server maintenance)[/b]

Eve, Frank, Hilary and Owenstein would like to help adventurers like you by providing useful items for the colder weeks and months to come. You’ll find them in the Central Plaza of Varanas (Channel 1).

The four of them are especially interested in Healing Potions of Redemption, Link Runes, Mind III and Magic III. So use this opportunity and exchange these items to receive rewards like the Birthday Cake or Birthday Muffin, the Badge of the Trial and much more!

Eve, Frank, Hilary and Owenstein won’t be in the region for long, however, so visit them while you can and take advantage of their offers!

[h2]Event 3: Time for Your Workout[/h2]

[b]Duration: 19th October (midnight) to 25th October (11:59 PM local time of the server)[/b]

Do you need more experience and talent points? Then this is the right event for you, because all experience points you earn from quests or combat are increased by 300%. The talent points collected in battle are also increased by 300%.

[h2]Event 4: Autumn Shopping Fever[/h2]

[b]Duration: 20th October (after the server maintenance) to 27th October (until the next server maintenance)[/b]

After a short break, Owenstein and Hilary have returned to the Central Plaza of Varanas (Channel 1).

These two are searching for rare Rhinoceros Blood which they’ll exchange for an incredible selection of wares including the Proofs of Myth and the Peak Experience Orb.

Tip: you can purchase Rhinoceros Blood from Black Codex merchants with Ancient Mementos.

Have fun in our autumn events!
The RoM Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/f5b26fa056c22a151f5653943a95499b263420bf.png[/img]

[i]When the Eye of Wisdom first came to Candara, the land was very underdeveloped. There was a great shortage of lumber, a farmer used a pumpkin to carve a mask like these and then when he put a candle inside, it seemed to come to life.

When the leaders at the Eye of Wisdom heard of this, they marked this day as a day of celebration so that the people could take a rest before the hard winter. Everyone put on these pumpkin masks and gathered to enjoy a friendly chat and some delicious pumpkin dishes. notes.content:
[b]Patch 7.4.0.2920 - Juice Festival[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/43ceea3bc9f7469adec405a3fb7b2c8a04687bf9.jpg[/img]
[b]Juice Festival[/b][/h2]
During the bustling moonlight grapefruit season, the aroma of freshly pasteurized juice fills the streets and hard-working men and women gather together to share a cold mug of juice and talk about the past year. Great juice makers' doors stand open day and night for crowds of happy revelers.

The juice celebration gets bigger and bigger every year. The Phirius Workshops have picked up on the popularity and profitability of these gatherings, and are now coordinating these folk activities and promoting them in different places. This year, Juice Festival activities are being held in every town and city and merriment fills the air, alongside the aroma of freshly made juice.

[h1][b]Fairytale Festival[/b][/h1]

[i]Once there was a travelling bard called Aylit. When passing through towns and villages he would tell his friends all kinds of interesting stories which happened on his journeys.
One day, he met Falbala, the beautiful but sad daughter of a nobleman. To make her smile, Aylit would often tell her some made-up stories, and he noticed that bit-by-bit they had an effect on the girl.
Encouraged by Falbala, he began to tell the people all kinds of stories, and they spread and became very popular. The story-lines and their conclusions became topics the people discussed in their leisure time.

The Phirius merchants trade collections of these stories and each year choose a special subject to start a fairy tale event. To enter the city during that time would mean to be in the same fairy tale dreamland together with everyone else.[/i]

notes.title: A Summer Month Full of Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/742197d599f0743f2f15a042ef35fa7536c0b220.jpg[/img]

Even couch potatoes know this Taborean summer is going to be hot. The inhabitants are enjoying a well-deserved vacation and are wading in crystal-clear water to escape the scorching sun. You should also go for a cool swim, because Runes of Magic will be heating up in the coming weeks!

[h3]    [b]How It Works[/b][/h3]

Different, exciting events await you each week this month in Taborea. This includes a boost event and an event where you can get your hands on the highly sought after [b]Proof of Myth, High Quality Peak Fragments and Peak Experience Orbs[/b]. Don’t miss out on the fun!

[h2]    [b]Event 1: As Much as You Can Carry[/b][/h2]

[b]Duration: 3/8/2020 (12:00 AM) to 10/8/2020 (12:00 PM server local time)[/b]

Grab more loot: receive a drop rate increased by 200% during the event – this is your chance to get shiny, new armor for your adventure!

[h2]    [b]Event 2: Shopping Fever[/b][/h2]

[b]Duration: 10/8/2020 (12:00 PM) to 17/8/2020 (12:00 PM server local time)[/b]

Eve, Frank, Hilary and Owenstein didn’t travel to the coast to relax with all their friends. No, they stayed here to help supply adventurers like you with useful items. You can find them in the Central Plaza of Varanas (Channel 1). 
So use the occasion to get rewards like the Birthday Cake or Birthday Muffin, the Badge of the Trial and more! Because these four will definitely need a small vacation by the end of the event.

[h2]    [b]Event 3: Busy Point Collector[/b][/h2]

[b]Duration: 17/8/2020 (12:00 AM) to 24/8/2020 (12:00 PM server local time)[/b]

You want experience and talent points? Then this is the right event for you, because all the experience points won through quests or battles here are increased by 200%. Talent points collected in battles are increased by 500%.

[h2]    [b]Event 4: After the Vacation is Before the Vacation[/b][/h2]

[b]Duration: 24/8/2020 (12:00 PM) to 31/8/2020 (12:00 PM server local time)[/b]

After a short break Frank and Hilary have returned from faraway lands to the Varanas City Plaza (Channel 1). They have brought back an amazing selection of goods: get excited for the Proof of Myth, Peak Fragments and Peak Experience Orbs.

Have fun in our summer events!
The RoM Team

notes.title: Patch 7.4.0.2917 - Colorweave Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/555124bd51da145765824f5ae236a899ca0c4367.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Colorweave Festival[/b][/h2]

Legend has it that the earliest people didn't wear clothes. When bad weather came, they couldn't do anything but huddle together for warmth and wait for it to pass. The weak and feeble gritted their teeth and endured the cold without help from anyone. People would die from exposure if there was a cold snap. They were slaves to the weather.

Then one night, the gods dispatched an envoy wearing clothes that were seemingly weaved from a rainbow. Just to look upon their brilliance was to be bathed in soft, soothing moonlight. Her name was Lunella, and she came to teach people how to weave clothes and survive winter's cruelty. This event marked the very beginning of our concept of beauty. Afterwards, a few pioneers popped up and started experimenting with dressing up. They designed new styles that focused not just on warmth, but on the beautiful and vibrant too.

After the people had mastered weaving, Lunella quietly made her exit. She has not been seen since. In order to honor the memory of Lunella's graciousness, people prepare their most beautiful clothes and come together every year at this time. The festival is meant to symbolize the permanence of Lunella's teachings. They will continue to be handed down and live forever in the minds of generations to come.

[h1]Crafting Festival[/h1]

[i]A long time ago, the world was very chaotic. Nations were engaged in an endless war, and the people didn't dare imagine what tomorrow would bring. Many families were impoverished and displaced.

After a long time the war finally came to an end, and the craftsmen who had been forced to produce weapons used their skills to help the people. All of the craftsmen were happy to be able to stop making weapons and contribute something to the people. They worked hard to make people happy.

By working from before dawn until late into the night, the tireless efforts of these craftsmen improved the lives of the people in a short six months. In order to keep the Craftsman Spirit alive, future generations of craftsmen from all over show off their own work and learn from each other every year at this time.

Every time this season comes around, the craftsmen work tirelessly to show off their crafts in order to fulfill the "Craftsman Spirit" that has passed down over the years. These craftsmen who are usually busy working are even busier during this time...

Many events are waiting for you, come and help the craftsmen and enjoy the festival and the flea market![/i]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/61fec9778be5c9abe0dac6f2c6e6c1412bfd06df.jpg[/img]

[h1]Music Festival[/h1]
The anniversary of Julia Habin is coming soon, and as every year the villages are organizing musical activities to celebrate and sing the songs that Julia sang to pacify the lonely children left behind by the war in Kolydia.

It’s again that time when streets are filled with music and everyone returns to their villages to witness this wonderful show.

As usual, many activities are planned for celebrating, in particular around Silverspring and Thunderhoof Hills. notes.title: Spring in the Taborean Air
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/6da205d9ecbb70a68fc1c70f247936c01df42986.jpg[/img]

Winter is slowing losing its icy grip on the lands. All across Taborea, Wabbits are emerging from bushes and burrows to enjoy the gentle sunshine. Wabbits and clement weather – what else do you need to celebrate spring in Taborea? Ah, of course! Events! If you prefer to celebrate the holidays with exhilarating action rather than relaxation, we’ve got just the thing.

[h2]    [b]Boosts event[/b][/h2]
[b][u]Between 10.04 00:00 AM and 13.04.2020 11:59 PM (local server time respectively)[/u][/b] you can look forward to an experience and talent point event: experience points you earn on quests and in combat will be increased by 200%, while you earn 500% more talent points in combat. You can also take advantage of a 200% increased drop rate!

[h2]    [b]Easter Gift[/b][/h2]
There’s a surprise in store for you every day [b][u]between 10.04 and 13.04.2020[/u][/b], and you can look forward to various useful items to help you on your adventures. If you have multiple characters on your account, the presents will land in the mailbox of the first character you log in with. Even if you miss a day during this period, it won’t have any effect on the remaining presents.

[h2]    [b]Draco Mania – Get Them All![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/e6c12b80681d115e7f82019a8212236d6b9357ba.jpg[/img]

Arthomon loves his Draco companions. The strong, faithful creatures always provide him with courage and succor. He wishes more Humans, Dwarves and Elves could enjoy their friendship. For this reason, he has asked his friends Owenstein, Frank, Eva and Hilary to visit Varanas for a short while. They will allow you to exchange Draconaris, so that everyone can appreciate the loyalty these adorable creatures offer.
 
You can visit Owenstein, Frank, Eve and Hilary in Varanas Central Plaza (channel 1) [u][b]between 8.04.2020 8:00 AM (CEST) and 16.04.2020 08:00 AM (CEST)[/b][/u] to exchange your Draconaris! Please note that you can exchange up to a maximum of 5 times per day per account.

Have fun!
The RoM Team

notes.title: It’s Stomping Time: New for PvP Fans
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/eb81fc599fcdb16ccbb9bc70f9ce167fe424bfea.jpg[/img]

Join the Stomping Grounds and battle with up to 30 other players – only one team can win! Can you survive to the end?

[h3]3, 2, 1, STOMP![/h3]
The battle is for 25 to 30 players above level 100, and you can register either alone or in a group of up to 6 friends. You start out with heavily reduced combat stats, but these can be increased over time by killing monsters, taking out enemies or opening chests.

[h3]Victory![/h3]
Claim victory by being the last surviving team or combatant! In reward you can receive Copper and Silver Stomping Coins which can be exchanged with mercenaries outside the battlefield.

The number of coins received for victory depends on the size of the team. Increase your chances of winning by selecting a team of skilled operators – or greed out on the loot as a lone wolf!

[h3]Defeat?![/h3]
The fun doesn’t stop when you die – click the button to join the spectators and watch the rest of the battle unfold. Irrespective of whether you’re alive or dead at the end of the battle, you’ll receive 200 Copper Stomping Coins for sticking around to the end.

[h3]Draw[/h3]
Battles on the Stomping Grounds end after 14 minutes, irrespective of whether any team has claimed victory. In the case of a tie after this time, the spoils are divided between the surviving teams.

[h3]More Power![/h3]
In order to increase your stats on the Stomping Grounds, you need to collect power-ups. You can also use special items to give you more power.

These items can be purchased for Copper Stomping Coins from mercenaries outside the battlefield, or looted directly from chests and defeated monsters on the Stomping Grounds. You can equip up to 6 items in the field, and any excess items will overwrite the oldest item. Power-ups you find are equipped automatically, while items purchased for Stomping Coins must be equipped manually before entering the battlefield.

Thirty chests containing items and power-ups spawn at the start of the battle; the large chests contain three random items, while the small ones only contain one.

[h3]Beat the Boss![/h3]
At the corners of the Stomping Grounds you’ll find fearsome bosses which grant powerful buffs to the person who delivers the killing blow. But watch out! If that person is then killed by another player, the buff is passed on to them.

[h3]Danger, Danger![/h3]
During the battle, the combat area will be reduced by a mysterious circle of fog. You’ll receive a warning each time before this happens. If you’re in one of the areas cut off by the deadly fog, you’ll take damage and should head to the safe reduced area of the Stomping Grounds as quickly as possible. The combat area will shrink ever smaller as time passes.

[h3]Loot![/h3]
You can spend your Copper Stomping Coins with mercenaries for special booster items for your next battle, or exchange them for up to three random chests per day.

Silver Stomping Coins are more valuable, and can be used in exchange for an exclusive mount or PvP gear, for example.

Ready to stomp your enemies? Then join the fun and show everyone how big your boots are!

Have fun,
The RoM Team

notes.title: Runes of Magic’s Turning 11!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/2abd2d37694c840ee590050dc7b62208a62da58c.jpg[/img]

Over a decade full of magic and adventure lies behind us, and it’s an absolute honor to be able to celebrate this grand occasion with you, the heroes of Taborea!

We’re extremely proud and grateful to have completed this amazing journey with you all. Together we’ve made new friendships, forged plans, created guilds, crafted weapons, and experienced countless adventures.

It’s been seriously epic, and we hope that we will still be fighting by your side for many years to come. And to celebrate Runes of Magic’s 11th anniversary, we want to show our gratitude to you with a series of serious events!

[h2]    [b]Anniversary Festival[/b][/h2]
[b]12th March to 7th April 2020[/b]

The legendary Anniversary Festival has tons of in-game activities for you to participate in and earn valuable rewards.

[h2]    [b]Boost Event[/b][/h2]
[b]16th March (midnight) to 22nd March 2020 (11:59 PM)[/b]

Play, have fun, and scoop up the loot! During the event there’s more experience and talent points to be earned, plus higher drop rates for everyone:
[list]    [*]EXP +200%[/*]    [*]TP +500%[/*]    [*]Loot chance +200%[/*][/list]
[h2]    [b]Proofs of Myth[/b][/h2]
[b]12th to 19th March 2020 (11:59 PM)[/b]

Battle your way through a range of instances and collect Proofs of Myth to exchange! The bosses in the listed instances are all carrying proofs. Rally your friends and guild members around you to loot them. Remember that each boss has a fixed number of proofs on them, regardless of how many friends you take them down with.

Here’s where you can get the Proofs of Myth:
[list]    [*]Sirloth in the Hall of the Demon Lord[/*]    [*]Sydaphex in the Hall of Survivors[/*]    [*]Hidden Box in Sardo Castle[/*]    [*]Jenny Giant in the Tomb of the Seven Heroes (Hard)[/*][/list]
In addition, the bosses in the Ancient Dreamland will drop Coins of Generosity which you can exchange for more proofs from Owenstein on the Central Plaza in Varanas City.

[h2]    [b]Login Event[/b][/h2]
[b]17th to 20th March 2020[/b]

Log in each day and collect gifts for RoM’s birthday! Each day we’ll be sending you a different present per in-game parcel. If you have multiple characters, the first character you log in with will receive the gift.

[h2]    [b]Anniversary Raffle[/b][/h2]
[b]12th to 22nd March 2020[/b]

Take part in [url=http://gf.link/Rom11thAnniversaryRaffle]our raffle[/url] and win some special mounts and pets! We’re giving away 10 shop coupons for each of a superb anniversary mount, pet and costume.
Taking part couldn’t be easier, simply carry out the little quests on our social media portals to have your name added to the hat.

[h2]    [b]Top Shop Offers[/b][/h2]
[b]12th to 29th March 2020[/b]

During the offer period you can snap up fantastic items from the Anniversary Fortune or seize the chance to get a rare Halloween title. These boxes are waiting in the item shop:
[list]    [*]Anniversary Fortune[/*]    [*]Vampire Lord Chest[/*]    [*]Butcher Beast Chest[/*]    [*]Alpha Werewolf Chest[/*]    [*]Prince of Darkness Chest[/*]    [*]Skull Collector Chest[/*][/list]
[b]Brand-new Mounts, Pets and Costumes[/b]

Keep your eyes peeled and you can also pick up brand-new mounts, pets and costumes plus other extremely rare items in our other shop offers.

Join us and let’s get this party started!
One extremely proud RoM Team

[h2]Flower Festival[/h2]
A long time ago, there lived a poor painter named Aiglo. He met a girl by chance named Naro while he was painting in the wild, with whom he fell instantly in love. But Naro was from a rich family, and Aiglo knew he would not have a chance. During his moments of sadness, a friend came and advised him to seek help from the Flower God. Flica Orly, a preacher of the Flower God, told Aiglo that he should plant a blue rose in Naro's garden to show his love for her. Aiglo tried many times but finally succeeded. That blue rose symbolized the miracle that would bring Aiglo and Naro together.

Naro was moved by what Aiglo did and their story spend around town. Soon everyone was asking for blessings from the Flower God and lived happily ever after. Over the years, everyone celebrated the Flower Festival at this time of the year.

[i]In the past, when the frost and snow fell and the moon disappeared from the sky, the Frostmoon Demon Beast Thysdyr would awaken from his sleep and cause destruction everywhere. At the time, the people had no way to stop him, so they could only flee. They would wait for Thysdyr to leave, then return to rebuild their homes. The villagers lived through this nightmare year after year, until one year at this time, a strangely-dressed traveler came to visit even though he knew the terrible beast would attack.

That night, as Thysdyr's angry roar drew nearer and nearer, the traveler sat in the empty city, quietly waiting...

The next day, the villagers returned to find their village untouched. Surprised, they asked the traveler what had happened. It turns out that Thysdyr was afraid of rune-catalyzed flame. This exciting news spread quickly to all the nearby villages. After that, every time the Frostmoon Beast awoke, he could only continue to hide in the darkness.

Many years have passed, and Thysdyr hasn't been seen for a long time. But every year when the snowy season arrives, people build a giant pyre and dance around it, throwing in rune catalysts. They celebrate day and night, and call the celebration the Festival of Fire. [/i]

notes.title: Update: Off to Chassizz!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32991126/7b33c050bde2f89868836236efcee11bae49907c.jpg[/img]

Patch 7.4.0 is here – and with it lots of exciting new challenges! Help the Hand of Balance establish a post on the volcanic island and face the Inexorable League in their final fortress.

Chassizz is the easternmost island in the Shataem Archipelago. The entire island is characterized by its unique terrain, which was created when the volcano at the center of the island erupted.

The island is crawling with dangers because it’s under the control of the Inexorable League, which rules it from the Celestial Spire. The New Pantheon lies within, well protected. Whatever they’re planning there must be stopped!

[h1]    [b]New Content[/b][/h1]
[h2]    New Zone: Chassizz[/h2]
The island is waiting with lots of new main quests and side quests that you can play to progress your character.

[h2]    New Instance: New Pantheon[/h2]
The New Pantheon is the last of our enemies’ hiding places. The temple was constructed with the help of the Naga and can be reached through the entrance deep within the Celestial Spire.

There are 5 bosses waiting for you there:[list]    [*]Czerkonis will put you to the test. Are you strong enough to pass the trial?[/*]    [*]Lady Timata doesn’t fight alone: she has an army of her own children to fight beside her.[/*]    [*]The Chassizzene Nex is drunk on divine power and doesn’t want to let go of it again.[/*]    [*]Nekdar will use his entire arsenal to stop you from getting any further.[/*]    [*]Zhargos’ ‘Experimental Body Enclosure’ will be your last battle in the Pantheon. Prevent a Chaos Storm from being unleashed.[/*][/list]
Defeat them in combat and seize your rewards!

[h2]    New World Boss[/h2]
A new world boss awaits you in the Entity Chamber. Be careful – the whole place seems highly unstable.

[h2]    New Leveling System – Introducing ‘Peak Levels’[/h2]
While the level cap will stay at 100, there is a new kind of level known as ‘Peak Levels’.

To unlock them you’ll have to complete the quest ‘Crossing the Mountain Path’ from Leya Peak in Varanas. Once you’ve unlocked it, the experience points that you collect will be calculated at this new level.

Peak values are linked to bonus buffs for movement speed, gold and drop rate as well as attribute increases for your character.

The upper limit currently available is Peak Level 5.

[h2]New Gear[/h2]
As in every new zone, there are powerful items that you can equip your character with. You can get new pieces of equipment from merchants, quests, by crafting and of course, in the New Pantheon.

[h2]    Temporary Catch-Up Servers[/h2]
Together with the release of 7.4.0 we are opening two temporary servers that will rapidly speed up leveling. So if you’d like to try out a new character or return to RoM after a break, now is the perfect time! You can find information about the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/808290/announcements/detail/3727223146671156254]temporary servers here[/url].

[h2]    Other News[/h2]
The Snowflake Festival is back with new quests and a wonderful new Ice Crystal Snowboard! Click here to view all the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/808290/announcements/detail/1690470114820771660]Festival information[/url]!

Naturally, there are [url=https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/808290/announcements/detail/1705106180198266260]events[/url] and special offers during the Christmas period for you to enjoy! Just stop by the shop and forum!

The RoM Team.
